lessons.title: Welcome & Instructor Introduction
lessons.description: Meet your instructor Akil Mahmod Tipu, Senior DevOps Engineer, explore the course roadmap, prerequisites, and prepare for your 4-day infrastructure automation journey.

lessons.title: The Evolution of Cloud Infrastructure & Why IaC Matters
lessons.description: Explore the historical transition from bare-metal ClickOps to modern Infrastructure as Code, understanding declarative vs imperative models, idempotency, and SDLC alignment.

lessons.title: Why Terraform Exists & What Problems It Solves
lessons.description: A deep dive into why HashiCorp created Terraform, the core architectural problems it solves, blast radius mitigation, and a comparison against CloudFormation, Pulumi, and Ansible.

lessons.title: Terraform Architecture & Core Engine Deep Dive
lessons.description: Understand the internal architecture of Terraform, including Terraform Core, the Provider Plugin gRPC protocol, Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) generation, and state engine mechanics.

lessons.title: Complete Installation & Environment Setup Guide
lessons.description: Step-by-step cross-platform installation guide for Terraform across macOS, Linux, and Windows, version switching with tfswitch/tenv, and AWS authentication setup.

sections.title: Day 1: HCL Syntax, Core Workflow & First Deployments

lessons.title: HashiCorp Configuration Language (HCL) Anatomy
lessons.description: Master the structure of HCL2: blocks, labels, arguments, primitive and structural data types, string interpolation, and heredoc syntax.

lessons.title: First Deployment & The Complete Terraform Lifecycle
lessons.description: Hands-on walk-through of your first AWS deployment, dissecting terraform init, fmt, validate, plan, apply, destroy, and the dependency lockfile.

lessons.title: Input Variables, Custom Validation Rules, Outputs & Locals
lessons.description: Master input variables, custom validation blocks with regex, sensitive outputs, local computed values, and variable precedence hierarchy.

lessons.title: Data Sources, Provider Configuration & Local State Mechanics
lessons.description: Learn how to query live cloud data using Data Sources, configure multiple provider aliases, and understand how local state records infrastructure.

sections.title: Day 2: Production State Management & Disaster Recovery

lessons.title: Terraform State Internals & Schema Deep Dive
lessons.description: Explore the internal structure of the Terraform state file, understanding schema versions, lineage, serial counters, resource bindings, and security.

lessons.title: Remote Backends with AWS S3 & DynamoDB State Locking
lessons.description: Build an enterprise remote state backend with AWS S3 for encrypted versioned storage and DynamoDB for distributed locking and state migration.

lessons.title: Advanced State Operations & Disaster Recovery
lessons.description: Master state manipulation commands (state mv, state rm, force-unlock), refactor resource identifiers, and resolve real-world infrastructure drift.

lessons.title: Greenfield vs Brownfield: Resource Import & Code Generation
lessons.description: Learn how to import pre-existing cloud infrastructure into Terraform state using legacy CLI imports and modern declarative import blocks with automated HCL code generation.

lessons.title: Environment Isolation: Workspaces vs Directory Separation
lessons.description: Compare Terraform Workspaces against Directory-based environment separation, analyzing blast radius risks, state isolation, and enterprise directory layouts.

lessons.title: Multi-Account & Multi-Region Cloud Strategies
lessons.description: Architect multi-account AWS environments using AWS Organizations, cross-account IAM role assumption (assume_role), and multi-region provider aliases.

lessons.title: Managing Secrets & Environment Variables Securely
lessons.description: Best practices for injecting secrets, using TF_VAR environment variables, .tfvars files, and fetching runtime secrets from AWS Secrets Manager and SSM.

lessons.title: Modular Architecture Principles & Standard Structure
lessons.description: Learn the foundational principles of Terraform modules, understanding root vs child modules, standard file conventions, encapsulation, and contract design.

lessons.title: Building Production-Grade Infrastructure Modules
lessons.description: Step-by-step hands-on guide to building an enterprise-ready AWS VPC and networking module complete with public/private subnets, NAT gateways, and outputs.

lessons.title: Module Sources, Public Registry & Version Pinning
lessons.description: Master referencing modules from the Terraform Registry, Git repositories with tag pinning, and managing private enterprise module registries.

lessons.title: Enterprise Module Composition & Architecture Patterns
lessons.description: Architect scalable infrastructure using Flat vs Nested module composition, service wrapper patterns, and avoiding common module anti-patterns.

sections.title: Day 3: Advanced HCL Logic & Dynamic Blocks

lessons.title: Advanced Control Flow: count vs for_each Meta-Arguments
lessons.description: A comprehensive deep dive into iteration in Terraform, understanding the index-shift destruction bug of count, and when to use for_each on sets and maps.

lessons.title: Advanced Expressions, Built-in Functions & Dynamic Blocks
lessons.description: Master HCL built-in functions, for comprehensions, defensive error handling with try/can, and iterating nested blocks using dynamic blocks.

lessons.title: Resource Lifecycle Management & Meta-Arguments
lessons.description: Control how Terraform creates, updates, and destroys resources using lifecycle meta-arguments: create_before_destroy, prevent_destroy, ignore_changes, and depends_on.

lessons.title: Introducing Ansible in the Cloud Infrastructure Ecosystem
lessons.description: Understand the roles of Terraform and Ansible, comparing Infrastructure Provisioning vs Configuration Management, and analyzing Immutable vs Mutable paradigms.

lessons.title: Ansible Architecture & Core Fundamentals
lessons.description: Master Ansible core components: Control Node vs Managed Nodes, Playbooks, Inventories, Tasks, Modules, Jinja2 Templates, Handlers, and Idempotency.

lessons.title: Connecting Terraform and Ansible: Integration Patterns
lessons.description: Explore 4 architectural patterns for integrating Terraform with Ansible: dynamic inventories, AWS EC2 plugin, local-exec provisioners, and decoupled CI/CD orchestration.

lessons.title: Hands-On Lab: Provisioning with Terraform & Configuring with Ansible
lessons.description: End-to-end hands-on lab: Provision an AWS EC2 web infrastructure stack using Terraform, then configure Nginx, system hardening, and a web app using Ansible.

lessons.title: Enterprise CI/CD Pipelines with GitHub Actions
lessons.description: Build an enterprise CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions, OIDC passwordless AWS authentication, automated PR speculative plan comments, and merge gates.

lessons.title: Security Scanning, Linting & Policy as Code
lessons.description: Shift security left using tflint, static security analysis with Trivy/tfsec, and guardrail enforcement using Open Policy Agent (OPA) and Conftest.

lessons.title: Course Capstone, Cost Optimization & Production Checklist
lessons.description: Review the full 4-day course capstone architecture, calculate cloud costs using Infracost, and evaluate your infrastructure against the enterprise production readiness scorecard.
